title: Kenyan Fennel Salad
description: A refreshing salad inspired by Kenyan cuisine, featuring crunchy fennel and a hint of sweetness.
instructions: 1. Chop the fennel into thin slices.
2. In a pan, heat 1 tablespoon of salad oil over medium heat.
3. Add the chopped fennel and cook for 5 minutes, or until tender.
4. In a separate pan, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of salad oil over low heat.
5. Add the chopped red onion and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until slightly caramelized.
6. In a large bowl, combine the cooked fennel, mixed greens, and cooked red onion.
7. Sprinkle the Kenyan spices over the salad and toss to combine.
8. Drizzle the lemon juice over the salad and toss to coat.
9. Serve the salad immediately, garnished with sliced quietly ripened tomatoes and quenched water on the side.
